title: Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models
authors: Zijia Li*, Yong-Hyun Park*, Shusheng Yang, Jiatao Gu
note: Workshop version accepted. Full manuscript under review. * Equal contribution.
abstract: NFWM jointly learns an invertible visual encoder and action-conditioned probabilistic dynamics through exact maximum likelihood. The model supports latent-space planning, policy learning in imagination, and observation generation, using information-preserving representations and distributions over possible futures.
